message.content:
Welded stainless steel pipes, circular cross-section, fall under heading 7306. Subheading 7306.40 covers "other, welded, of circular cross section, of stainless steel."

Under 7306.40:
- 7306.40.10 is "Of an outside diameter not exceeding 9.5 mm" ... actually, the structure is 7306.40.10 for the pipe-and-tube category "Not containing by weight 0.5% or more of nickel"? I need to recall this more carefully.

HTSUS 7306.40:
- 7306.40.10: Welded, of circular cross section, of stainless steel, "Containing by weight less than 0.5% nickel"? I believe the actual structure is:
  - 7306.40.10 – Containing by weight less than 0.5 percent of nickel (older: "Not cold-drawn or cold-rolled")
  - 7306.40.50 – Other, with 7306.40.5005, 5040, 5060, 5075, 5085, 5090 and similar
  - 7306.40.20 – Containing 24% or more nickel
  - 7306.40.30 – Other
  - 7306.40.50 – Other: 7306.40.5042, 5044, 5062, 5064 (cold-drawn/cold-rolled)

I recall that 7306.40.50 is "Other" with statistical suffixes. Under 7306.40.50: 7306.40.5005 (Containing less than 0.5% nickel...?), 7306.40.5015, 5040 (Other, nickel 0.5%+ but less than 24%?), 5042 (Not cold-drawn, outside diameter less than 19mm), 5044, 5062 (Other: outside diameter under 19 mm, wall thickness 1.65 mm or more), 5064 (other), 5075, 5085.

In the CBP rulings for these goods, the cold-drawn polished pipes with nickel between 0.5% and 24% and wall thickness at least 1.65 mm were classified in 7306.40.5064 (outside diameter exceeding 19 mm, wall thickness 1.65 mm or more). That one is the best-known classification, although the diameter isn't stated.

{"hts_code": "7306.40.5064", "reason": "Welded, circular cross-section stainless steel pipes (cold-drawn, polished, wall thickness of 1.65 mm or more, nickel 0.5% to under 24%) fall under heading 7306, subheading 7306.40.50, and this statistical suffix is the best fit; the outside diameter was not given, so it is assumed to exceed 19 mm."}

predicted_reason: Welded, circular cross-section stainless steel pipes (cold-drawn, polished, wall thickness of 1.65 mm or more, nickel 0.5% to under 24%) fall under heading 7306, subheading 7306.40.50, and this statistical suffix is the best fit; the outside diameter was not given, so it is assumed to exceed 19 mm.
